newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian money market rates were steady in brisk trade on Monday, characterised by good supply of kuna funds as well as high demand, dealers said.
"The day began with a high demand for loans and a good supply of kuna funds. However, there still remains some 15 million kuna on the supply side," one dealer said.
New loans totalled 20.5 million kuna, up by roughly a third from Monday.
Most of the borrowings were call money loans granted at an unchanged 11 percent rate.
One smaller eight-day loan was granted at 13 percent.
Monday's overnight trade totalled 100 million kuna with no banks reporting shortfalls and the money being used for maintainance of the banks' mandatory reserves.
